packageRules.description: Default: chore(deps) so tooling bumps (devDependencies, GitHub Actions, pre-commit hook revs, Docker base digests, docs-site) don't cut a release
One weekly PR for all non-major tooling bumps instead of one PR per package; majors stay separate PRs
docker-compose.yml is what self-hosters run: a digest pin would freeze them on one :latest image
Runtime web deps change what ships: fix(deps) cuts a release
Runtime API deps ([project.dependencies]) change what ships: fix(deps)

uvicorn (selfhost group) ships in the release image; dependency-groups can't be told apart by depType, so match by name. The aws group (boto3, mangum) stays chore: releases ship only the selfhost image, and Lambda deploys don't use releases
Weekly lock file refresh is maintenance: chore(deps)
